title: Security review of entire application
description: Conduct a comprehensive security review of the application, focusing on credential handling, DDL safety, and data exposure.
acceptanceCriteria: Credential handling is reviewed for security
No sensitive data is exposed in logs or responses

statusHistory.reason: Cross-cutting security task derived from PRD Non-Functional Requirements section 5.2

evidence: Commit: ad09e9ddff5af3db93d529b552f9e8b70fabd219 TASK-069: add security review report for entire application (pushed to origin/ticket/TASK-069)

Security review report: reports/security/TASK-069-security-review.md — all 5 acceptance criteria PASS (credential handling, DDL execution safety, no data exposure, security best practices, report produced)

Unit tests (root, Docker node:20-alpine, docker compose -f docker-compose.unit.yml run --rm --user ... tests): 29 files / 368 tests passed, exit code 0 — including src/serialization/diagramSerializer.test.ts 19/19 (credential-absence), src/components/ExportButton.test.tsx 5/5 (no-credentials download), src/__tests__/useConnection.test.ts 17 (3 session-clearing), src/components/DdlPreview.test.tsx 12 (preview + confirmation)

Unit tests (backend, Docker node:20-alpine, docker run ... node:20-alpine sh -c 'npm test'): 9 files / 177 tests passed, exit code 0 — including src/services/ddl-safety.test.ts 42, src/services/ddl-generator.test.ts 19, src/services/ddl-safety-validator.test.ts 23, src/routes/apply-schema.test.ts 24, src/routes/test-connection.test.ts 12, src/routes/read-schema.test.ts 12; 3 integration test files / 17 tests self-skipped (no PostgreSQL env vars)
Semgrep SAST (Docker returntocorp/semgrep:latest v1.182.1): 0 findings with .semgrep/credential-in-export.yaml (2 rules) and p/typescript (74 rules) on 55 files in src/

Code review: backend/src/routes/test-connection.ts (router-based handler returns raw err.message which may contain password — minor finding), backend/src/middleware/error-handler.ts (generic 500, no stack traces leaked), backend/src/services/connection-test.service.ts/introspection.service.ts/postgres-connection.service.ts (password sanitization in error messages), backend/src/services/ddl-safety.ts/ddl-safety-validator.ts (dual DDL safety validation), backend/src/routes/apply-schema.ts (confirm requirement + transaction + statement_timeout), src/serialization/diagramSerializer.ts (stripCredentials defense-in-depth), src/hooks/useConnection.ts (in-memory credentials only, cleared on session end)
Risk rating: Low — all 5 acceptance criteria met, 2 minor hardening recommendations documented in report
